outline: This course will start with the review of three Laws of Thermodynamics. Emphasis will be placed upon the applications of thermodynamics in materials-related topics. The applications will include: calculation of phase diagrams and phase transformations, solution thermodynamics of multi-component systems, such as those in alloys. The equilibrium of chemical reactions is also an important part of this course.
schedule:
week 1-4: Chap. 2-4, 6 Review for First, Second, Third Law of Thermodynamics
week 5-7: Chap. 5 Auxiliary functions , Chap. 7 Phase equilibrium
week 9: Midterm exam
week 10-11: Chap. 8/9 Gas behavior/ Solutions
week 12-14: Chap. 10/15 Phase diagram, phase transformation/ spinodal decomposition, nucleation and growth
week 15-17: Chap. 11-13 Reactions, defect reactions
week 18: Final exams
assessment:
40% assignment and class performance
30% midterm exam
30% final exam
